'''Pandarrior''' is a [[Grass]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Pandaroot]] at 18 stars and into [[Pandagrand]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Once it believed that cuteness alone could earn enough food, but for just a little more honey, Pandarrior chose to get a job. Life is a grind when you've got honey on the mind."

Pandarrior is a red rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A white and green panda that gleefully carries three honey-filled bamboo shoots, with one of them being balanced on its head. It also only stands on one of its legs.

Padarrior's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces green with cyan.

== Evolution Trial ==
Pandarrior's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 36 stars. To evolve it into [[Pandagrand]] you need to complete the following three tasks:

* Feed this Tatari to B quality.
* Shoot 60,000 pinballs.
* Feed Pandarrior Bamboo Stew x15

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Pandarrior often use Drunken Fist or Wing Chun to fight Zobos. Sometimes sitting on them works too."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Pandarrior delights crowds with honey-filled bamboo stunts, trading any candies earned to refill the jars."
